mechanism: Establish one stable subject silhouette and a small graphic motif family, progressively reorganize those elements into denser flat layouts, insert one brief low-information reset, then reconstruct a held final composition using only the established graphic family.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable silhouette and one dominant graphic anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unanchored collage has no identity.

invariants.rule: Increase layout density using only established motifs and palette.
Preserve subject identity through at least one major reorganization.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the subject turns it into a montage.

invariants.rule: Use one brief low-information reset before the final build.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous density has no structural turn.

invariants.rule: Resolve the established motif family into a held final lockup.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated end card discards prior history.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the exact angular panels and title copy
the exact gray reset and final poster
